A '''decrypt unit''' was a decryption [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. [[Thella]] needed one to decrypt a [[processor]] her team stole from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[Loh'khar]] the Finder told her she needed an [[interface pad]] instead.
